title: Deep-learning classification of physically admissible nuclear-matter equations of state
summary: Thermodynamic stability and causality impose fundamental constraints on the equation of state (EoS) of nuclear matter. Verifying these constraints conventionally requires calculating quantities such as the specific heat, baryon-number susceptibility, and speed of sound, which can become computationally expensive when many candidate EoSs must be examined. We investigate whether the normalized pressure surface, $Q(T,μ_B)=P(T,μ_B)/T^4$, alone contains sufficient information to determine the physical admissibility of an EoS.
